Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.
We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As a Principal Software Engineer leading Fleet Management, you will be the overall technical lead across three pods and the person who sets the technical direction for the fleet management layer of Roblox. This is a hands-on, deeply technical leadership role that owns all of Roblox's compute capacity end to end: from low-level provisioning and the data plane, up through the control planes that operate it, and all the way to the UI and internal-facing products that let teams self-serve capacity. Your org centralizes security, maintenance operations, and the uptime of every Roblox Kubernetes cluster, and governs the internal customer contracts that drive automation across the fleet spanning Roblox data centers and cloud providers. You will guide architecture, raise the engineering bar, and make sure compute capacity supply and demand stay in balance as the fleet grows.
You will:
Serve as the overall technical lead for three Fleet Management pods, setting and aligning the technical direction across low-level provisioning, the data plane, and the control plane and product surfaces above them.
Architect the declarative, Kubernetes-style control planes that operate Roblox's compute fleet across on-prem and cloud, and define how capacity is provisioned, reconciled, and exposed at scale.
Own the design of the internal customer contracts and APIs that govern automation across the fleet, so that every infrastructure team can operate capacity safely and predictably.
Drive the strategy for self-serve capacity, including the internal-facing products and UIs that let teams request, manage, and reason about the compute they depend on.
Centralize and raise the bar on security, maintenance operations, and the uptime of all Roblox Kubernetes clusters, defining how fleet-wide changes ship reliably without impacting production.
Partner broadly with stakeholders inside and outside infrastructure to understand compute needs and drive innovation for our backend services, AI, and edge computing.
Write code daily, staying deep in the systems your org owns and leading by example on the hardest design and implementation problems.
You Have:
10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems and infrastructure.
A track record as the technical anchor an organization relies on, with the leadership to set direction across multiple teams and up-level the engineers around you.
Strong proficiency in Go, with deep experience designing and operating production services at fleet scale.
Hands-on experience building declarative, Kubernetes-style control planes and the reconciliation patterns behind them.
Strong proficiency with gRPC for service-to-service APIs and with SQL and Postgres for durable, high-scale state.
Experience operating compute capacity across both on-prem data centers and cloud providers, and a feel for the realities of running fleets at the scale of hundreds of thousands of instances.
A history of being highly cross-functional, partnering with stakeholders across and beyond infrastructure to design systems that keep compute supply and demand in balance.

jobs.description: The Global Partner Program (GPP) is unifying Intuit's partner ecosystem into one coherent growth engine. The Accountant track is the largest and most complex segment in that ecosystem, with thousands of practices ranging from solo practitioners to national firms, each with different economics, referral behavior, and appetite for QuickBooks Online Accountant products. Today that segment is split across legacy programs with inconsistent benefits, onboarding, and measurement. You will design, scale, drive adoption, and own the unified program architecture, and you'll own partner adoption, tier progression, and engagement actually move. This is a build role at a principal-level with a high-visibility mandate: you'll own the commercial strategy for how Intuit grows and monetizes the long tail of accountant partners - and the programs that scale it. You'll operate at the intersection of Product, Business Development, Enablement, Marketing, Support, Legal, and Data - shaping decisions across all of them without owning any of them directly - and you'll be judged on the growth, adoption, and economics of that channel, not on how many workstreams you touched. A bar raising strategy here starts with a genuine, first-hand understanding of partner needs and is built to win for Intuit, win for partners, and win for the shared customer. This is a critical hire: the unified program's success rides on getting that strategy right. Responsibilities Strategy & Program Design Define program architecture, business rules, success metrics, and governance in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Translate platform strategy and partner insights into concrete programmatic capabilities that scale globally. Develop and execute adoption strategies that drive customer growth, partner engagement, and sustained usage across all phases of the unified Partner Program rollout. Drive adoption, growth, and scale across the long tail of thousands of practices - improving partner sentiment and experience - through tiering, self-serve enablement, and automated benefit delivery. Ground every program decision in direct partner input - economics, feedback, and behavior. Lead the strategy, design, and operating plan for scaling complex partner-facing initiatives - commercial models, tiering and benefits, incentives, enablement, and support. Launch Planning & Execution Drive end-to-end planning and rollout for new or evolving program features, partner readiness, and internal visibility, while serving as a trusted adviser for internal and external stakeholders. Build business requirements documentation (BRDs) and sequencing logic, drive cross-functional alignment, and plan phased rollout in partnership with technical and other stakeholders. Partner with Program PMs and cross-functional teams to coordinate the migration of existing Accountants and Firms into the new program structure. Manage phased rollout and onboarding experiences for net-new partners, ensuring alignment with benefits, systems readiness, and communications. Lead readiness reviews and status tracking across product, enablement, and support teams to ensure operational alignment at each stage of the rollout. Partner Experience & Operational Development Own the end-to-end partner journey - onboarding, activation, benefits, support, and how it's tracked - partnering with internal tooling teams (PRM, CRM, Billing) to govern workflows that give real-time visibility and a genuinely good partner experience. Set the bar for partner education and engagement, working with Partner Marketing and Enablement to ship it. Serve as the central liaison across GTM, Ops, and Partner-facing teams to surface gaps in readiness or friction in adoption workflows. Close the loop on partner and support feedback by turning it into iteration and roadmap decisions. Lead operational integration for strategic program capabilities (e.g., performance tracking, point systems, benefit redemptions), and hold GTM, Ops, and partner-facing teams accountable for closing identified gaps. Business Operations & Measurement Define and maintain KPIs to evaluate program effectiveness across dimensions such as partner engagement, activation, tier progression, or adoption/usage. Partner with Data, Analytics, and Rev Ops to align telemetry, dashboards, and reporting pipelines to business objectives. Synthesize metrics into actionable insights for program leadership, and influence roadmap prioritization based on partner adoption trends. Own the P&L for the long-tail segment of the channel - cost per partner, cost per tier, cost of benefit delivery and support, and margin by tier, including rebate envelopes, run-rate floors/ceilings, and anti-stack rules - holding the line on profitability as adoption and scale increase, while influencing (not owning) the channel's overall P&L so long-tail growth doesn't quietly erode economics elsewhere in the portfolio. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance Shape decisions in strategic planning forums and cross-functional working groups - not just attend them. Drive alignment across legal, finance, product, enablement, and partner-facing teams to ensure policy adherence and system integrity. Lead internal change management around new program rules, lifecycle updates, or incentive frameworks. Lead the narrative in executive briefings, WBRs, QBRs, and partner council forums, bringing adoption insights and partner sentiment signals to the table. Own the Partner Council end to end including charter, cadence, and agenda, and represent Intuit at industry events and conferences as the face of the accountant partner ecosystem. Qualifications 10+ years in partner program strategy, GTM operations, channel strategy, or non-technical product management - ideally with direct exposure to accounting-firm or practice-management economics (client advisory services, referral/rev-share models, how a firm owner actually evaluates a partner program), not just SaaS partnerships. Program Building: direct experience building a partner program completely from scratch - writing and driving alignment around the v1 strategy paper, setting foundational assumptions, and executing the launch. Track record of owning the P&L for the long-tail segment of the channel - including cost to serve, unit economics by partner, cost per tier, cost of benefit delivery and support, and margin by tier, including rebate envelopes, run-rate floors/ceilings, and anti-stack rules. Partner Economics & Profitability: hold the line on profitability as adoption and scale increase, while influencing the channel's overall P&L so growth is economically sound across the portfolio. Fluency in SaaS commercial models - Affiliate/Referral, Revenue Share, Reseller - and how each changes partner behavior and program design. A demonstrated track record of building programmatic mechanisms - tiering, self-serve enablement, automated benefit delivery - that grow a long tail of thousands of small-and-mid partners without a linear increase in headcount. You've scaled a channel, not just managed a portfolio of key accounts. Strategic Problem Solving: a genuinely ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problem you framed and solved from a blank page - not a pre-scoped roadmap you executed. Results Oriented: a track record of owning a growth or acceleration metric end-to-end and hitting it, with a bias to action over process for its own sake. Boundaryless Influence: a specific instance of mobilizing Legal, Product, Enablement, and Finance to break a cross-functional deadlock - without direct authority over any of them. Experience with Salesforce, PRMs, Airtable, Asana, or Confluence is a plus. Bonus: experience scaling a tiered partner program globally with regulatory compliance and revenue recognition in mind. Identify readiness gaps through feedback loops with managers and new hires, and develop targeted content to close them.

Serve as the embedded enablement partner to FAE leadership, maintaining a close pulse on what the teams need as the business scales.
Collaborate with the broader Enablement team to adapt existing GTM enablement content for engineering audiences and bring engineering learnings back to the org.
Manage multiple concurrent programs with clear milestones, keeping stakeholders informed on roadmap progress and program effectiveness.
Report on program health and outcomes to engineering and Enablement leadership on an ongoing basis.

jobs.description: Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations! AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States) Key job responsibilities The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center.
